text:
Elaine (People Ops): Hey everyone — quick follow-up from today's all-hands. Opening this thread for live Q&A on reviews, leveling, promotions, comp, and benefits. We'll be answering for the next couple hours. Quick reference: promo window opens 2026-05-10, manager calibration meetings 2026-06-07 to 2026-06-09, comp letters target 2026-06-15. Playbook: https://intranet.redwood/career-playbook

Sam (Eng): Thanks! If my manager submits a later effective date, is pay retroactive to the requested effective date or to the payroll run?

Elaine (People Ops): Good Q. We apply the new base retroactive to the effective date on the manager submission. Payroll processes on 2026-06-15, so if effective date is earlier, the delta is paid in that run. See FAQ in the playbook under "Comp timing".

Jamal (Manager): Manager question — during calibration, are we allowed to move people across bands or only within band sublevels? Need to know for our calibration prep.

Elaine (People Ops): You can recommend band moves if you have documented leveling rationale. Calibration is for cross-team consistency; moves across bands will need an explicit write-up and 2+ manager approvals. We'll post the calibration rubric and a short checklist in 10 min.

review-bot: Posted: Manager calibration rubric and checklist -> https://intranet.redwood/calibration-rubric (doc id 12345) :robot_face:

Maria (Eng): Is there any change to the expectation around IC -> EM transitions? I have someone in mind but want to prep the candidate and manager.

Elaine (People Ops): No change to the core criteria. For IC->EM we expect evidence of cross-team impact, direct mentoring, and management readiness interview. For promotions to leadership tracks we also require org-level sign-off. We have a short template managers should fill out: paste below:

```
Candidate name:
Current level:
Proposed level/track:
Key evidence (bullets):
Org impact / stakeholders:
Manager endorsement summary:
```

Jamal (Manager): Perfect, thanks. Can we get a sample filled template? That would help calibrators.

Elaine (People Ops): Yes — adding two anonymized examples to the rubric doc in 20 min.

Nora (Finance): Small note on comp: for equity refreshes tied to promotion, we're doing case-by-case grants this cycle due to budget phasing. Managers should flag high-priority candidates in their submission form so we can reserve pool.

Sam (Eng): Thanks Nora. Any guidance on communicating promotion/comp outcomes to the IC before manager-level payroll is finalized?

Elaine (People Ops): Managers can share the promotion and new level once final approvals are in, but when comp numbers are pending, use this template language: "Promotion approved; comp details finalizing, expected by <date>." Avoid promising specific $$ until comp letter is finalized.

Patrick (CTO): Quick leadership note — we're prioritizing promotions that unblock product plans (critical hires becoming IC managers, etc.). If a manager thinks a promo is mission-critical, please mark that as "high priority" in the form and ping me or Elaine.

Maria (Eng): One last ask — will there be calibration office hours for managers who want to run through edge cases?

Elaine (People Ops): Yes. We'll run two 1-hr office hours sessions the week before calibration (calendar invites out tomorrow). Also open to 1:1s for any tight timelines.

Sam (Eng): Awesome, appreciate the clarity. :thumbsup:

Elaine (People Ops): Thanks all — I'll keep answering here and will summarize the Q&A into a short follow-up note after the thread closes. If you want a private follow-up, DM me.
